meta.source: Music Station canvas mockups: Home, navigation header, Live Tuner, key column, File Analysis, Settings (Sep 2026)

tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Window background; also the well behind inputs, readouts, meters and the note grid. Also the pressed state of secondary buttons.

tokens.name: bg-chrome
tokens.usage: Header strip, tool bar strip and ruler rows.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Panels: projects, pitch detection, editor, inspector, arrangement, mixer. Also the transport strip.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Secondary buttons, the selected project row, the selected track, the active Settings section, tab hover, the Not listening pill.

tokens.name: surface-active
tokens.usage: Hover on secondary buttons and list rows; pressed toggles (active tool, Mixer on, the active Grid/Notation segment).

tokens.name: border-subtle
tokens.usage: Panel outlines, strip dividers, track row dividers.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Control outlines: inputs, selects, secondary and M/S/R buttons.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Bar lines in rulers and grids; outline of the active toggle.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body text and button labels on bg, surface and surface-raised.

tokens.name: ink-strong
tokens.usage: Large readouts (the detected note name), playhead line and marker.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: breadcrumb, dB values, ruler numbers, icon buttons.

tokens.name: ink-subtle
tokens.usage: Labels, captions, section overlines, units (Hz, BPM, dB). Passes 4.5:1 on bg, surface and surface-raised.

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Decorative only: breadcrumb and header dot separators, inactive track dots. Below 4.5:1, never for text that must be read.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Primary actions only (New project, Play, Open piano roll), MIDI notes and clips, the tuning needle, the app mark. One primary button per panel.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on accent and mute fills. Never white.

tokens.name: accent-tint
tokens.usage: Amber wash behind icon tiles, e.g. the recent-project tile on Home.

tokens.name: pitch
tokens.usage: Pitch and selection: in-tune band, detected key and row, selected note, audio tracks and clips, Listening dot, level meters. Also the Solo-on fill (label on-pitch) and the 2px focus ring, offset 2px.

tokens.name: pitch-text
tokens.usage: Blue text on dark grounds: Listening label, in-tune offset readout.

tokens.name: pitch-well
tokens.usage: Background of the Listening pill and the selected-note card.

tokens.name: on-pitch
tokens.usage: Text on a pitch fill, e.g. the detected key label.

tokens.name: pitch-edge
tokens.usage: Dividers and borders inside pitch-well elements: the header pill divider, expanded result tiles.

tokens.name: pitch-lane
tokens.usage: Tint across the piano roll row of the live detected note.

tokens.name: selection-ring
tokens.usage: 1.5px outline on selected notes; text on selected table rows (on pitch-well).

tokens.name: record
tokens.usage: Record button icon and the record-armed fill (label on-accent); destructive text buttons such as Remove selected plugin. State only, never decoration.

tokens.name: mute
tokens.usage: Fill of an active mute button (label in on-accent). Paired with dimmed clips at 40% opacity.

tokens.name: key-white
tokens.usage: White piano keys.

tokens.name: key-black
tokens.usage: Black piano keys; drawn 26px shorter than white keys. Labels in ink-muted.

tokens.name: key-white-hover
tokens.usage: Hovered white key (click to hear the note).

tokens.name: key-black-hover
tokens.usage: Hovered black key; label switches to ink.

tokens.name: key-label
tokens.usage: Note names on white keys (every key is labelled; below 16px rows only Cs and the detected key).

tokens.name: lane-white
tokens.usage: Piano roll grid rows of white keys.

tokens.name: lane-black
tokens.usage: Piano roll grid rows of black keys.

tokens.name: ghost-note
tokens.usage: Legacy single-colour ghost. With track colours, other tracks' notes show in their own track colour at 22% opacity, not editable.

tokens.name: track-1
tokens.usage: Track colour 1 (amber, same as accent); assigned in order to new tracks.

tokens.name: track-2
tokens.usage: Track colour 2 (rose).

tokens.name: track-3
tokens.usage: Track colour 3 (violet).

tokens.name: track-4
tokens.usage: Track colour 4 (green).

tokens.name: track-5
tokens.usage: Track colour 5 (sand).

tokens.name: track-6
tokens.usage: Track colour 6 (teal).

tokens.name: track-7
tokens.usage: Track colour 7 (coral).

tokens.name: track-8
tokens.usage: Track colour 8 (lime). After 8 the palette repeats. No blue in the palette: blue means selection and the mic note.

groups.name: Interface
groups.note: IBM Plex Sans, weights 400, 500, 600. Hosted on Google Fonts.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: One panel headline per screen at most.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Open the polyphonic piano roll with your current notes.
styles.usage: Descriptions, list item names (weight 500), button labels (500/600).

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Form labels, tool buttons, status pills.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Mixer strip names, small labels in dense rows.

groups.name: Readouts
groups.note: IBM Plex Mono, weights 400, 500. Every number, note name and unit uses it.

styles.name: readout-hero
styles.usage: Detected note on the Home pitch panel. Octave digit at 72px in ink-subtle.

styles.name: readout
styles.usage: Detected, Target and Offset tiles; inspector note name (34px).

styles.name: readout-sm
styles.usage: Transport position; compact pitch readout in the transport (26px).

styles.name: meta
styles.usage: Metadata, dB, pan, units, M/S buttons (600).

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between list rows, label to input, icon to text.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap inside button groups and mixer strips.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between tiles and between the arrangement and mixer panels.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Gap between panels; window padding on editor screens; piano roll row height.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Header and strip side padding; Home window padding; panel side padding.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: M/S/R buttons, clips, segmented toggle items (6px).

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, selects, icon buttons. List rows and tiles use 10px.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Panels.
